newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Quito bolsa electronic trading extended two hours.
newsitem.headline: Quito bolsa electronic trading extended two hours.

text.p: Quito Stock Exchange announced a two-hour extension of its electronic trading session from Tuesday.
The extension from 0930 local time (1430 GMT) to 1600 (2100 GMT) "is expected to boost investment opportunities," a stock market spokesman said.

Quito stock market was so far closing at 1400 local time (1900 GMT) and the new measure put its closing in line with that of the electronic trading session of the bolsa in Guayaquil, on the Ecuadoran coastline.
